Passersby take pictures of an Iranian actor depicting Donald Trump in a mock prison cell attached to a billboard in Tajrish Square, Tehran.

A Mediterranean mantis (Iris oratoria) clings to a plant, stretching out its arms and legs in a defensive display. As a survival strategy, mantises try to make themselves appear as large and imposing as possible to potential predators. The Mediterranean mantis is particularly quick to become defensive—even when a photographer gets too close.
